<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_VacationRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/vacation-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacation Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_VacationRequest" name="Vacation request process starts">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Submit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Submit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Submit_Register</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Submit_Register</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReceiveRequest" name="Receive vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_Decide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewRequest" name="Approve or reject vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_Decide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Review_ApprovalGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Request approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Review_ApprovalGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnApplication" name="Return application to employee">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return_ReviewReasons</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewReasons" name="Review rejection reasons">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return_ReviewReasons</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewReasons_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Rejection reviewed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewReasons_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateNotification" name="Generate notification to Human Resources Representative">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notification_Procedures</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteProcedures" name="Complete vacation management procedures">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notification_Procedures</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procedures_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approved" name="Vacation management procedures completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procedures_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Submit" sourceRef="StartEvent_VacationRequest" targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Register" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_Receive" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Decide" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_ReviewRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_ApprovalGateway" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_GenerateNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_ReturnApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_ReviewReasons" sourceRef="Task_ReturnApplication" targetRef="Task_ReviewReasons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewReasons_End" sourceRef="Task_ReviewReasons" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notification_Procedures" sourceRef="Task_GenerateNotification" targetRef="Task_CompleteProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procedures_End" sourceRef="Task_CompleteProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_Approved"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
